label: Himalayas
terms_note: Keyless JSON feed; the payload asks that jobs carry the 'Originally posted on Himalayas' credit; no published rate limit.

auth: 1. No account needed for the public feed; the tenant applies on the posting's own application page (assist card).

endpoints.notes: jobs[]: title, excerpt, companyName, companySlug, employmentType, min/maxSalary, currency, seniority[], locationRestrictions[], categories[], description, applicationLink, pubDate, expiryDate; totalCount, nextCursor

reference.limits: - Keyless; payload embeds 'Originally posted on Himalayas' — keep that credit. - Client should switch from offset to nextCursor (audit finding).

adapter.rate_note: https://himalayas.app/api (read 2026-09-25): 'The service applies rate limiting; exceeding limits returns a 429'; no figure is published and the page size is capped at 20. One request per second.
adapter.terms: Attribution required: 'link back to the URL found on Himalayas AND mention Himalayas as the original source'; do not submit Himalayas jobs to third-party job aggregators.

search_postings.note: GET https://himalayas.app/jobs/api/search (q free text, page 1-based, sort; also country, worldwide, seniority, employment_type, company, timezone). `query` → q; `category` → employment_type (one of Full Time, Part Time, Contractor, Temporary, Intern, Volunteer, Other — use Contractor for freelance/contract gigs); newest first (sort=recent). Pages hold 20 jobs (the documented maximum), so limit is not sent. min_budget is not sent (no salary filter). budget_min/budget_max are the salary range (salaryPeriod in raw, often annual), skills = categories, description = excerpt (full HTML in raw.description); pubDate/expiryDate are Unix seconds in raw. Attribution: link back to the Himalayas URL and name Himalayas as the source.

not_offered.me: Keyless public API; no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: Only the browse feed (/jobs/api) and search (/jobs/api/search) are documented; there is no per-job endpoint — re-read the record (id = guid) from the search hit.
not_offered.submit_bid: No application API; candidates apply at applicationLink (Himalayas or the employer).
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the page documents the jobs feed and search only.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API; the page documents the jobs feed and search only.
not_offered.credits: Free API; no account or credit endpoint.
